title: Before the Ticket: Grounding HPC User Support in Documentation and Resolved Tickets with an Agentic LLM Assistant
abstract: arXiv:2610.31703v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most questions that reach an HPC help desk have already been answered in the center's user guides or in a ticket someone else filed last semester; users still file new tickets because the guides are hard to navigate and the ticket history is not theirs to search. We present an assistant that answers from both sources: an orchestrator calls two tools over the Model Context Protocol, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over the live documentation and a Llama-3-8B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on 11,244 query-resolution pairs mined from historical tickets, and merges their answers. Every model runs on-premises or on the university's hosted LLM service because ticket data may not leave the institution. On 400 held-out tickets from Purdue's Rosen Center for Advanced Computing, disjoint from training and free of near-duplicates, and evaluated by two judges from model families that generated none of the answers, fine-tuning on resolutions rewr

translated_title: 提交工单之前：利用智能体式大语言模型助手，将HPC用户支持根植于文档与已解决工单之中
translated_abstract: HPC（高性能计算）帮助台收到的大多数问题，其实早已在计算中心的用户指南或他人此前提交的工单中得到过解答；但用户仍然不断提交新工单，原因在于指南难以导航检索，而工单历史也不允许用户自行搜索。我们提出了一个能够同时从这两种信息来源作答的助手：一个编排器通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol, MCP）调用两个工具——一个针对实时文档的检索增强生成（RAG）工具，以及一个在从历史工单中挖掘出的11,244对“问题-解决方案”数据上使用QLoRA微调的Llama-3-8B模型——并将二者的答案加以融合。由于工单数据不得离开本机构，所有模型均在本地部署，或运行于大学托管的LLM服务之上。在普渡大学罗森先进计算中心的400个保留工单（与训练集互不相交且不含近似重复样本）上进行评估，由两位来自未参与生成任何答案的模型家族的评判者进行打分，结果表明在历史工单解决方案上进行微调……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个完全本地化部署的智能体式LLM助手，通过MCP协议编排实时文档RAG检索与在11,244条历史工单“问题-解决方案”对上QLoRA微调的Llama-3-8B模型并融合二者答案，从而在用户提交工单之前就解答其HPC使用问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a fully on-premises agentic LLM assistant that orchestrates, via the Model Context Protocol, a RAG tool over live documentation together with a QLoRA fine-tuned Llama-3-8B trained on 11,244 query-resolution pairs mined from historical tickets, merging their answers to resolve HPC users' questions before they ever file a ticket.
